name: TLS certificate verification disabled
description: tls.Config.InsecureSkipVerify = true lets MITM read/modify traffic. Use proper CA bundle (x509.SystemCertPool or custom). CWE-295 (Improper Certificate Validation).

name: os/exec with shell interpolation
description: exec.Command("sh", "-c", stringWithArgs) or "bash" -c allows shell injection if strings contain metachars. Use exec.Command(name, args...) with no shell. CWE-78 (OS Command Injection).

name: Weak hash (md5/sha1) for security purposes
description: md5/sha1 is collision-prone; do not use for signatures, passwords, tokens. Use sha256/sha512 (hash/crc32 for integrity only). CWE-328 (Weak Hash).

name: Weak PRNG (math/rand) for secrets
description: math/rand is deterministic (seeded by time); do not use for tokens, salts, nonces. Use crypto/rand. CWE-338 (Use of Cryptographically Weak PRNG).

name: SQL query interpolated with user input
description: fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM x WHERE id=%s", in) is SQL injection. Use prepared statements: db.Query("SELECT ... WHERE id=?", in). CWE-89 (SQL Injection).

name: template.HTML unescaped user input
description: template.HTML(userInput) marks a string as safe and disables HTML escaping → XSS. Use text/template or html/template auto-escape. CWE-79 (XSS).

name: http/plaintext listener without TLS
description: net/http ListenAndServe on 0.0.0.0:80 or :80 without TLS terminates traffic in cleartext. Use http2/tls.Listen or a reverse proxy. CWE-319 (Cleartext Transmission).

name: JWT HS256 with weak / hardcoded secret
description: jwt.NewWithClaims(jwt.SigningMethodHS256, ...) with a hard-coded secret makes token forgery trivial. Load secret from env/KMS and rotate. CWE-798 (Hard-coded Credentials).

name: file permission 0777 / world-writable
description: os.Chmod(path, 0777) / os.OpenFile(..., 0666) leaves the file writable by everyone on multi-user hosts. Use 0640/0644 or stricter. CWE-732 (Incorrect Permission Assignment).

name: Hard-coded AWS / generic secret in Go source
description: AKIA[ASLOIDQW]{16} or long secret-looking string assigned to key/password/secret. Move to env or secrets manager. CWE-798 (Hard-coded Credentials).

name: unsafe pointer cast to interface
description: unsafe.Pointer / uintptr conversion used in non-internal code is a classic source of memory-safety bugs and GC bypass. Audit necessity. CWE-843 (Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type).

name: Deserialización insegura de pickle
description: pickle.loads / pickle.load puede ejecutar código remoto arbitrario durante la deserialización. Usar SafeLoader, json, o un esquema firmado. CWE-502 (Deserialization of Untrusted Data).

name: Uso de eval() en datos dinámicos
description: eval() interpreta strings arbitrarios como código y permite ejecución de código remoto cuando la entrada no es controlada. Preferir ast.literal_eval o if/elif. CWE-94 (Code Injection).

name: Uso de exec() en datos dinámicos
description: exec() ejecuta código arbitrario y es una puerta de RCE directa si la entrada no es controlada. CWE-94 (Code Injection).

name: subprocess con shell=True
description: subprocess Popen/call/run con shell=True pasa el comando por /bin/sh -c, permitiendo inyección de shell cuando las variables no se citan o son controladas por el usuario. Usar listas de args sin shell=True. CWE-78 (OS Command Injection).

name: os.system con command string
description: os.system() invoca /bin/sh -c con el string; permite inyección de shell. Usar subprocess con lista de args. CWE-78 (OS Command Injection).

name: yaml.load sin SafeLoader
description: yaml.load(constr=FullLoader/UnsafeLoader) deserializa tipos Python arbitrarios → RCE. Usar yaml.safe_load. CWE-502 (Deserialization of Untrusted Data).

name: peticiones HTTP con verify=False
description: requests.get/post(..., verify=False) deshabilita la validación de certificados TLS → MITM. CWE-295 (Improper Cert. Validation).

name: hash md5/sha1 sin context de seguridad
description: hashlib md5/sha1 no es apropiado para firmas, passwords, o tokens (colisiones). Usar sha256/sha512 con salt. CWE-328 (Weak Hash), CWE-757 (Hash Collision).

name: assert como comprobación de seguridad
description: assert() se elimina en producción con `python -O`. NO usar para validar permisos, input, o límites. Usar ValueError/PermissionError/Exception. CWE-754 (Improper Check for Unusual/Exceptional Conditions).

name: sqlite3 query interpolada
description: cursor.execute/execute() con f-string o .format() en el SQL → SQL Injection. Usar parámetros ? con placeholder. CWE-89 (SQL Injection).

name: tempfile con path predecible / mktemp
description: tempfile.mktemp y mkdir(name) con nombre predecible son vulnerables a symlinks. Usar tempfile.mkdtemp(). CWE-377 (Insecure Temporary File).

name: modulos telnet/plaintext
description: El módulo telnetlib transporta credenciales en plaintext. Deprecado en 3.13. Usar SSH. CWE-319 (Cleartext Transmission).

name: random para tokens/secrets (no crypto)
description: random.Random() usa PRNG determinista; NO usar para tokens, salt, nonce, o secrets. Usar secrets.token_hex/bytes. CWE-338 (Use of Cryptographically Weak PRNG).

name: credenciales hardcodeadas (AWS)
description: AWS Access Key ID (AKIA[ASLOID]+) o secret key en el código. Mover a env vars, AWS Secrets Manager, o SSM. CWE-798 (Hard-coded Credentials).

name: private key PEM en código
description: Blobs PRIVATE KEY / RSA PRIVATE KEY / EC PRIVATE KEY embebidos. Mover a almacén seguro. CWE-798 (Hard-coded Credentials).

name: path traversal con user input en open()
description: open(user_input) o os.path con input externo sin normalizar pueden escapar de raíz. Sanear con os.path.basename / pathlib.Path.resolve(). CWE-22 (Path Traversal).

name: curl piped directly to shell
description: curl ... | sh or | bash executes remote content with no integrity check (TOFU). Pin a checksum, download first, then verify and execute. CWE-494 (Download of Code Without Integrity Check).

name: wget piped directly to shell
description: wget -qO- ... | sh executes remote content without integrity check. Download first, verify, then execute. CWE-494 (Download of Code Without Integrity Check).

name: rm -rf with unquoted variable
description: rm -rf $DIR or rm -rf ${HOME}/... will delete the entire filesystem if the variable is empty. Always quote or validate the variable. CWE-22 (Path Traversal) / CWE-143.

name: chmod 777 / 666 world-writable
description: chmod 777 grants world rw to any user on the host. Use 750 / 640 / 600 depending on need. CWE-732 (Incorrect Permission Assignment).

name: SSH with StrictHostKeyChecking=no
description: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no accepts any host key → MITM possible on first connect. Pre-stage known_hosts or pin the public key. CWE-295 (Improper Certificate Validation).

name: eval with untrusted input
description: eval "$USER_INPUT" interprets arbitrary shell. Quote, sanitize, or avoid eval; prefer direct expansion of controlled tokens. CWE-78 (OS Command Injection).

name: curl/wget to plaintext HTTP
description: curl http://... or wget http://... transmits credentials/tokens in plaintext. Use https:// or a pinned CA. CWE-319 (Cleartext Transmission).

name: echo / printf of secrets to stdout
description: echo "$PASSWORD", printf '%s\n' "$TOKEN" — secrets land in shell history, logs, stdout captures. Mask with *** or redirect to fd. CWE-532 (Insertion of Sensitive Info into Log).

name: sudo -S reading password from stdin
description: sudo -S ... reads the password from stdin (often piped) and exposes it via pipe / process listing. Use a PAM module, keychain, or non-sudo user. CWE-212 (Info Exposure Through Error Message).

name: scp / ftp / sftp without key pinning
description: scp/ftp/sftp with default host key handling is vulnerable to MITM on first connect. Use StrictHostKeyChecking=ask and pre-staged keys. CWE-295.

name: history disabled or HISTFILE cleared in shared job
description: unset HISTFILE or histfile='' hides actions from audit; combined with admin shell it is often a persistence/anti-forensics move. Investigate if in a job script. CWE-778 (Insufficient Logging).

name: nc / netcat listener on 0.0.0.0
description: nc -l 0.0.0.0 / nc.lnk 0.0.0.0 exposes a listener to any source. Bind to 127.0.0.1 or a trusted interface. CWE-605 (Multiple Bind).

name: NSLog / print used to log sensitive data
description: NSLog, print(), or os_log can dump user credentials, tokens, or PII into device logs (visible to anyone with access). Strip or mask sensitive values. CWE-532 (Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File).

name: InsecureUnarchive / NSKeyedUnarchiver with untrusted data
description: NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchiveObject(with:) is deprecated and unsafe on untrusted data — deserialization of attacker-controlled payloads allows RCE via NSCoding. Use Codable/JSON or allow-listed classes. CWE-502.

name: CFNetwork / URLSession with TLS validation disabled
description: Ignoring SecTrustEvaluate / returning .ignoreCertAuth / using an empty allow-list lets MITM strip traffic. Always validate the chain with SecTrustEvaluate + pinned root. CWE-295.

name: Insecure HTTP (http://) endpoint
description: URL(string: "http://...") or HTTPURLSession on http:// transmits tokens/PINs in cleartext. Use https:// with App Transport Security (ATS). CWE-319.

name: Hard-coded API key / secret in source
description: Let apiKey = "sk-..." / let secretKey = "..." — secrets in source are leaked with the .ipa. Move to Keychain / config server. CWE-798.

name: KeychainItem with kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly missing
description: Storing secrets in Keychain without `kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly` lets them be copied via backup or other apps post-unlock. Pin the attribute. CWE-312 (Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Info).

name: SecTrustEvaluate not called on peer trust
description: Using SecTrustCreateCertificateColumns without SecTrustEvaluate (or evaluate(_:)) skips chain validation. Call SecTrustEvaluate or SecTrustEvaluateAsync. CWE-297 (Improper Validation of Certificate).

name: NSXPC / mach ports exposed with no auth
description: NSXPCListener / mach ports without an identity check let other apps invoke your services. Validate process / team id before handling. CWE-306 (Missing Authentication for Critical Function).

name: UserDefaults used for secrets/tokens
description: UserDefaults is world-readable on device (backed by plist). Store tokens, keys, and sessions in Keychain. CWE-312.

name: UIWebView (deprecated) — XSS surface
description: UIWebView is long-deprecated and allows navigation to arbitrary URLs with JS bridge. Migrate to WKWebView sandbox. CWE-79.

name: InsecureRandomNumberGenerator / SystemRandomNumberGenerator for secrets
description: Avoid SystemRandomNumberGenerator for tokens — use Crypto (SecureEnclave) or Keychain-backed randomness where applicable. CWE-338.
